note: BIC-based recovery among effect-conditioned trial-level readout models; not a full CRT POMDP comparison. The conditioning is necessary because the models are nested and a prior-averaged draw would often generate a null effect that M0 should win. A conditional pass after reducing the model set is not equivalent to a pre-specified full-set pass.

recovery_conditions.conditioning: each active condition effect has |delta| >= min_abs_effect
